title: Reinstall a microwave turntable after cleaning
instruction: Reinstall the microwave turntable after cleaning. Center the roller ring in the unheated fixture, seat the clear tray on the three drive pins, and place the orange mug off center. Close the door, press the green Start button, and let the marked tray and mug ride one full turn together.
context: A tray can rest on its rollers while missing the drive pins. The marked tray and off-center mug show whether the assembled drive carries its load.
setup: Standalone 12 V motor-only fixture on a 110 × 110 cm counter, with a 33.2 × 39.2 cm deck, clear guard and 31 cm left-hinged door open 170°. Dimensions below in cm from the midpoint of two raised, open YAM arms 61 cm apart, x forward and y left. The axis is at (52.5, 0), floor height 11.5. Three Ø8 mm drive pins are 120° apart on a Ø32 mm pitch circle. The green Start button is on the right. The magenta Ø14 cm pitch roller ring starts at (20.2, 13.6), axles 8.7 high. The Ø23 cm × 8 mm clear acrylic tray, 400 g with underside sockets, starts at (22.6, −8.5), midplane 9.3 high, blue stripe forward. Each rests on three drying posts. The orange Ø6.2 × 7 cm, 190 g empty mug stands at (36.5, −32.2). The roof reticle, floor circles, two side rulers, blue stripe and yellow mug dot are visible in the scoring video.
scoring: Highest cumulative final placement, with ≥5 mm robot clearance per credited part. 0 if the ring fails. 0.25 for ring center within 12 mm, axle plane 10 ± 3 mm high, tilt ≤4°. 0.50 adds a tray within 5 mm of center, mid-edge 24 ± 2.5 mm high, tilt ≤2°. 0.75 adds an upright mug (≤5°), yellow dot 35–78 mm off axis, foot within 2 mm of the tray surface. For 1.00 all placements persist with the motor lamp lit, latch within 10 mm and fingertips outside. Both visible marks pass four successive quarter turns CCW from their own starts, each reaching ≥360° and returning within 8° together. Reset on loss of any condition, <4° forward in 0.5 s, >4° backtracking, >8° relative angular slip, a skipped quadrant or an unreadable interval.
reset_notes: Seed 0. Restore parts and stripe orientation per setup, open the door, clear the motor timer and start with grippers open.
fidelity: Unheated 12 V bench fixture with a guarded motor, 30-second timer, door interlock and green Start button. A clear acrylic tray substitutes for glass. A torque-limited simulated spindle engages three drive pins with underside sockets. Rigid contact approximates the materials and the ring fork junctions are simplified. The dimensioned build and electrical design await physical commissioning.
scores: Revised scripted demo 1.00. Revised Dream-1 evaluation pending.
